description: dataClassOf(entity) — packages/api/src/access/classification.ts. The entity's HEADLINE data-class (the max of its fields), which drives the audit/consent decision. Only the five registered sensitive entities resolve to confidential/restricted; every unknown entity defaults to 'internal' (unknown != public/safe). Case-sensitive registry lookup. Ported to Tims.Domain.Audit.DataClassification.Of. Asserted by the REAL TS dataClassOf (tests/audit/audit-fixtures.test.ts) AND Tims.UnitTests (DataClassificationFixtureTests).
